_comment: Device profiler overhead CI golden (Blackhole). BRING-UP: real_time values are real measurements captured locally on a Blackhole (p100a, ENABLE_TRACY=ON, WITHOUT TT_METAL_PROFILER_ACCUMULATE), used as realistic placeholders; they are NOT gated yet. The runtime_perf_profiler_overhead CI job runs compare_profiler_overhead_ci.py with --ignore-times so only the benchmark set (names) is validated. Arm the gate by replacing these with a real benchmark_out JSON captured on bh_p150_perf CI silicon, then drop --ignore-times from the job. Metric = host-side real_time (ns) of the min aggregate: BM_profiler_read = ReadMeshDeviceProfilerResults writeout cost (dominant, ~9ms; largely fixed-cost - worst grid is only ~13% over single core), BM_profiled_dispatch = profiler-enabled EnqueueMeshWorkload+Finish (~37-39us; shape-insensitive, marker cost dwarfed by enqueue+finish).
